description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of ambiguity levels—Deceived, Partially Deceived, Not Deceived, and Ambiguity 2 (Inner)—as presented in the research paper “Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs.” The chart contains four slices, each representing a different ambiguity level. The largest slice, labeled “Deceived” and colored red, occupies approximately 67.9% of the chart. Next is a slice labeled “Partially Deceived” in yellow, taking up roughly 31.6% of the chart. A smaller slice, labeled “Not Deceived” and colored green, represents approximately 10.5% of the chart, while the smallest slice, “Ambiguity 2 (Inner)” in a lighter red, accounts for about 8.8%. The chart includes a legend identifying each color with its corresponding ambiguity level, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, starting with the largest and proceeding to the smallest.
